description: Implementation of QuicPollEventLoop class for handling socket events and alarms in QUIC protocol, including event registration, polling, and callback dispatching.

classes.name: QuicPollEventLoop
classes.description: Main class managing socket event polling and alarm scheduling.

classes.name: QuicPollEventLoop::Alarm
classes.description: Alarm class used for scheduling timed callbacks within the event loop.

classes.name: QuicPollEventLoop::AlarmFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating Alarm instances.

methods.name: RegisterSocket
methods.description: Registers a socket with specified events and listener.

methods.name: RearmSocket
methods.description: Rearms a socket with additional events.

methods.name: ArtificiallyNotifyEvent
methods.description: Manually triggers an event notification for a socket.

methods.name: RunEventLoopOnce
methods.description: Runs one iteration of the event loop.

methods.name: ComputePollTimeout
methods.description: Calculates timeout for poll based on alarms and pending events.

methods.name: PollWithRetries
methods.description: Performs poll syscall with retry on EINTR.

methods.name: DispatchIoEvent
methods.description: Dispatches IO events to registered listeners.

methods.name: ProcessAlarmsUpTo
methods.description: Runs alarm callbacks scheduled up to a certain time.
